projectDescription: A self-hosted web proxy application built on Node.js, Express, and Ultraviolet that bypasses network filters with tab cloaking, about:blank stealth, panic keys, and a built-in games and apps library.
keyFeatures: Ultraviolet-powered web proxy with XOR URL encoding via Service Workers
Tab cloaking (Google Drive, Docs, Google, Classroom presets)
Clickoff cloaking — auto-disguises tab on focus loss
Panic key — instant redirect/hide on configurable hotkey
Leave confirmation to resist DyKnow/GoGuardian redirects
Built-in games library (Retro Bowl, Slope, Cookie Clicker, Krunker, and more)
Built-in apps library (YouTube, Discord, Netflix, Spotify, GitHub, etc.)
Customizable themes (Deep Sea, Swamp, Ocean, Starry, Magma, Sunset, Equinox)
One-click deploy to Railway, Render, Vercel, Koyeb, and Cyclic
publicApiSurface: GET / — Home page with proxy search bar
GET /app — Alias for the main proxy interface
GET /bare/* — TOMP bare server (HTTP + WebSocket proxy relay)
GET /service/* — Ultraviolet service worker prefix (proxied content)
